name: Mont-Saint-Bruno National Park
policyReason: Sépaq allows dogs on three trails (Seigneurial, Petit-Duc, Grand-Duc) and three picnic areas; this entry is Mont-Saint-Bruno (Wikidata Q2051996), previously scraped with Boucherville pages.
summary: Dogs are allowed on three trails, Le Seigneurial, Le Petit-Duc and Le Grand-Duc, and in three picnic areas.

excerpts.quote: Aires de pique-nique (Les Étangs, Mémorial, du Moulin)

dogRules.text: Summer and winter trails: Le Seigneurial, Le Petit-Duc, Le Grand-Duc.
Picnic areas: Les Étangs, Mémorial, du Moulin.
No dogs on the water (nautical access).
